# EMET — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 12
**Agent:** EMET (Literal/Transparent)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 17-18 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 12

---

**12:1** Peter answered and spoke concerning these same things.

**12:2** He questioned them about the Savior: "Did he really speak with a woman without our knowledge and not openly? Are we to turn about and all listen to her? Did he prefer her to us?"

---

*Translator's Note (EMET):* Peter's three questions form an escalating challenge: (1) private speech — was it legitimate? (2) communal authority — should we listen to her? (3) hierarchy — did he rank her above us? EMET preserves the three questions without softening their edge. The verse is one of the most discussed passages in feminist-theological readings of Gnosticism.
